language_selection: Provisional English, German and Persian coverage; these are evaluation probes, not a compatibility claim. User language preferences were pending when frozen.
origin: Assistant-authored synthetic prompts and one plausible reference continuation per prompt; not private user writing or independently sampled natural text.
split_policy: Development examples may guide tuning. Heldout examples were frozen before inference and must not guide tuning. Any later tuning after heldout inspection requires a new independently authored holdout for confirmation.
quality_policy: References are examples, not exhaustive correct answers. Suggestion count is coverage. Semantic usefulness requires separately attributed rubric review; real typing benefit requires observed user trials.
